answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarization corresponds to text understanding and text generation processes.

answer_2.quote: We use the automatic metrics of ROUGE scores.

answer_4.quote: we asked four professional English speakers to rate the summaries from worst to best in terms of informativeness, faithfulness, topic coherence, and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: In the first experiment, we presented summaries and asked to rate them; in the second experiment, we applied the question answering (QA) paradigm with questions created to emphasize key information.
